content:
**Dent & Sons Construction** is a location in the Savage Divide region of Appalachia.

In the days leading up to the Great War, this location was undergoing excavation to prep for State Route 101 expansion southwards. Following the bombs and the ensuing chaos, a group of Raiders made this location their home.

A trailer home serves as the primary structure of this location. Around the area are a few dead Raiders that may be looted. Inside the trailer home is a Chemistry Station. Outside, two Radstags are hung up on a rack that may be looted, near a Cooking Station.

Dent & Sons Construction appears in *Fallout 76*.
